We’re back on the *Kottavalasa–Kirandul (KK) Line Doubling Project,* one of the most challenging railway infrastructure projects being developed through the rugged terrain of the *Eastern Ghats.*
Check Out Update from Chimidipalli Tunnel-28 & 29
In the previous video, we explored the construction progress around *Chimidipalli Railway Station,* including *Tunnel No. 28, Portal-02* & *Tunnel No. 29, Portal-01.*
This time, we’ve moved further towards *Borra Guhalu* to document the latest progress at *Tunnel No. 36 & Tunnel No. 37.*
